data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 晨光被单的永恒监视誓言
data.description: 清晨的薄光洒满凌乱的双人床。初尝禁果后的雪菜眼角含着动情的泪花，双手紧扣你的手掌，在发烫的耳语中羞涩低喃：“从今往后……雪菜会以妻子的身份，一辈子监视着前辈。”
data.location: sunlit morning bedroom with rumpled white linen sheets
data.action: lying tangled under white sheets, interlocking fingers, teary blissful expression, blushing ears, breathless whisper
data.lighting: soft serene morning sunlight washing over tangled sheets and flushed skin
data.mood: sacred romantic vow, heavenly morning peace, profound mutual devotion
data.promptProse: Tangled in white morning sheets with interlocked fingers, Yukina sheds tears of ecstasy and happiness, whispering her eternal love vow.
data.animaCaption: Interlocking fingers in the tangled morning sheets, she smiles with happy tears in the gentle sunlight.
